# High-signal filter

Curating or ranking to surface the *few high-quality items* out of a saturated, low-signal set — so a consumer can trust the shortlist instead of wading through everything.

**Test:** does the page build (or depend on) a trusted filter that separates quality from noise in a crowded market?
